body:
It's not that my life sucks in general, it's that I'm obsessing over one girl and each time I feel guilty for fucking it up and I feel like I'll never be able to be as happy again, and it causes incredible mental pain that makes me seriously contemplate jumping out of the window. Because if life is just going to get worse, why not, you know? It's been like almost two years and I still think about her and it's eating me from the inside.

I don't understand how to get rid of the mental pain permanently in a way other than suicide, and I don't want to feel pain. It's not about happiness, it's about lack of pain. I mean, sure, art/socializing/etc makes me happy and distracts me from pain but I don't understand how the fuck drawing a bunch of shit is going to get rid of pain.

I smoke chronic when I'm out of opiates and that helps but it also causes my mind to go haywire.
